UA Cast Player is a personal IPTV player. Import a playlist from the Channels tab (by URL or file), pick a TV guide source, and tap any channel to start watching. Use the Cast button to play on a Chromecast or Google TV device; if a stream can\'t be played directly on the receiver, the app automatically retries through a local relay on your phone.
Open the Channels tab and paste a playlist URL (m3u/m3u8), or pick a file from your device. The app remembers your last playlist and reloads it automatically next time.
It shows what\'s currently playing and what\'s next for each channel. Pick a source in Settings; the guide downloads in the background and matches channels automatically by tvg-id or name.

Tap the Cast button and choose a Chromecast or Google TV device. The app tries to play the stream directly on the receiver first; if the receiver can\'t handle it, the app automatically falls back to a local relay running on your phone.
The Channels tab groups your playlist into categories with a channel count for each. Tap a group to see and search its channels; the layout button switches between list and grid views.
Tap the star next to any channel to add it to Favorites. The sort button on the Favorites tab lets you order them by playlist position, alphabetically, or by when you added them.
What do the channel logo settings do?

Settings lets you choose whether logos are downloaded and shown, only shown from cache, or replaced with plain placeholders — useful on a slow connection or older device. You can also add your own icon sources, tried before the built-in one.
Tap the timer icon in the player to pause playback automatically after 15, 30, 45, or 60 minutes. It keeps counting down even if you switch channels, like a physical TV\'s sleep timer.
Everything - your playlist, TV guide, favorites, and downloaded icons - stays in the app\'s private storage on your device. See the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy for details.

Keep casting running in the background
Some phone makers (like Xiaomi) aggressively stop apps in the background, which can cut off casting to your TV. Allow UA Cast Player to ignore battery optimizations so playback keeps working.
